I traced the issue to two paths:

- [config/config.go](/app/config/config.go:72) defines and loads only `db.url`. Its default SQLite URL would also take precedence over new key/value settings unless the loader explicitly selects a configuration mode. This is where `DatabaseProtocol`, field validation, qualified errors, and TLS error wording belong.
- [storage/db/db.go](/app/storage/db/db.go:18) and [storage/db/migrator.go](/app/storage/db/migrator.go:30) both pass only the URL to the connection code. They need the same internal target selection and driver formatting. `NewMigrator` currently takes a pointer, contrary to the requested by-value interface.

There is a credential exposure risk in [db.go](/app/storage/db/db.go:109): URL parse errors include the raw URL, and wrapped connection errors may include a DSN. Existing tests cover URL-based configurations but no separate fields. `go test ./config` passes.

One detail remains to define in implementation: how SQLite’s file path maps to the proposed `host` and `name` fields. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). Per my fault-localization assignment, I made no source or test changes; the issue remains unresolved.

Implemented separate database configuration fields for protocol, host, port, user, password, and name. An explicit `db.url` takes precedence; otherwise, the application validates the fields and builds a connection target with engine specific default ports. `Open` and the by-value `NewMigrator` now use the same selection path. Configuration and TLS errors name their settings, and connection errors omit credentials.

Added tests for loading, validation, precedence, defaults, redaction, and connections. `go test ./config ./storage/db ./cmd/flipt -count=1` and `git diff --check` pass.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [config/config.go](/app/config/config.go:370) reads `db.port` with `viper.GetInt`. A nonnumeric value becomes `0`, causing the connection code to use the default port without reporting the invalid setting. Parse the value strictly and return a field-qualified `db.port` error.

**Tests executed:** `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./config ./storage/db` passed. `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./cmd/flipt` passed; that package has no test files. No `TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM`.

This was an independent review; I did not change project code or tests.

Fixed the reviewed `db.port` defect. Configuration loading now rejects nonnumeric and fractional ports with a field-qualified error instead of silently using the default port. Added regression tests for valid, malformed, and out-of-range values.

Both exact reviewer test commands passed: `go test ./config ./storage/db` and `go test ./cmd/flipt`, with `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off`.
